newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude trims earlier losses.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude trims earlier losses.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures consolidated at lower levels on Tuesday, trimming some earlier losses which were a correction to Monday's hefty gains.
September Brent was at $19.37 by 1400 GMT, nine cents a barrel down from Monday and six cents off the day's high.
August gas oil was $3.75 a tonne stronger at $176.00, playing catch-up to Brent's late Monday gains.
The market continued to wait for fresh news on the reemergence of Iraqi oil on world markets.
U.N. overseers are expecting Iraq's pricing formula for the second round of oil-for-food sales, an official said on Tuesday.
Assuming there were no objections, approval should take two days once the U.N. received the formula, the overseer said.

Underpinning crude's strength has been bouyant gasoline. Pressured by cat cracker problems at some NWE refineries and strong U.S. demand gasoline prices have been moving consistently higher over the last two weeks.
Dealers said the market was waiting for the APIs, which are released later today, to give some direction.
